title: 3.2 I, You and We
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Say I, you and we with ser and estar: Yo soy Ana, Tú eres Luis, Nosotros estamos hablando.
grammar_function: yo soy/estoy, tú eres/estás, nosotros somos/estamos.
speaking_outcome: Say who you are and what you and others are doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: wir + verb-en, like sie (they): Wir reden.
